top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.
Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
